title: Single hieratic sign, Berlin, Ägyptisches Museum und Papyrussammlung, P 3033 (AKU HT 12209)

object.name: Berlin, Ägyptisches Museum und Papyrussammlung, P 3033

source.attribution: Georg Möller, Hieratische Paläographie, retro-digitised by AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 12209

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 12209; AKU grapheme T0370 (AKU GR 628). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: T28 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 397. Source publication of this facsimile: Möller 1927a, p. 37, no. 397. Occurrence: line 24; find place Ägypten (unlokalisiert); writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; sign size 7.6 x 7.3 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Zweite Zwischenzeit, 17. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Retro-Digitalisat (Publikation), by Georg Möller. Source scan (WEBP) converted to PNG at native resolution, flattened onto white, white margin added.
